findings.highlight: she's sure that if she falls asleep tonight, she'll never wake up again.
findings.evidenceJa: 目が覚めない気がする
findings.governingReading: 目が覚めない気がする is a feared subjective prediction.
findings.explanation: Feeling she may never wake becomes sure she never will.

findings.highlight: Even she has someone willing to protect her.
findings.evidenceJa: 守ると言ってくれたモノがある
findings.governingReading: 守ると言ってくれたモノ refers to what he has promised to protect, followed by its remaining shape even if dirty/cowardly.
findings.explanation: Something he promised to protect becomes someone who protects her.

findings.highlight: She knows what it feels like when someone comes to kill her.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分を殺す為にやってきた事は空気でわかる
findings.governingReading: 自分を殺す為にやってきた事は空気でわかる identifies why this visitor came from the atmosphere.
findings.explanation: Sensing his current intent becomes general knowledge of what a killer feels like.

findings.evidenceJa: その殺意は空っぽだった
findings.governingReading: 殺意 means intent to kill, not relish or lust for blood, explicitly hollow yet painful.
findings.explanation: Empty murderous intent becomes empty bloodlust.

findings.highlight: he would combine their sins and face the consequences together.
findings.evidenceJa: 少女の罪も、この先少女が犯す罪も、全部一緒になって受ける
findings.governingReading: 少女の罪 and この先少女が犯す罪 both hers, shared acceptance by his arms.
findings.explanation: Her current and future sins become combining their sins.

findings.highlight: when her grandfather ordered her to go to the Emiya house, her dream came true.
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮の家に通って、ずっと、その望みを叶えてきた
findings.governingReading: 通って and ずっと望みを叶えてきた describe ongoing instructed visits and pursuit/fulfillment over time.
findings.explanation: Repeated visits and sustained wish fulfillment become a dream coming true when ordered to go.

findings.highlight: Why did she do this to him?
findings.evidenceJa: 自分たちはこんな事になってしまったのだろう
findings.governingReading: 自分たちはこんな事になってしまった asks how their shared condition came about.
findings.explanation: Why they ended this way becomes why she did it to him.

findings.highlight: if she judges him a threat to Sakura.
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐桜が衛宮士郎を敵と認識してしまえば
findings.governingReading: Even if Shirou supports Sakura, Sakura's own recognition of him as an enemy would make him an external enemy to be defeated.
findings.explanation: The condition for treating Shirou as an enemy changes from Sakura seeing him as one to Rider judging him dangerous. This alters the specific danger Sakura fears from Rider's continuing protection.

findings.governingReading: もう手遅れ concedes irreparable lateness while trying not to cause more trouble.

findings.evidenceJa: 咳きこむ胸を押さえながら
findings.governingReading: 咳きこむ胸を押さえながら states hand pressure on chest while coughing.
findings.explanation: Holding her coughing chest becomes holding back a cough.
